name: Eyeball It!
blurb: Five quick tests of how well your eyes judge angles, colors, counts and sizes. No rulers, just your eyes. Free to play in your browser.

name: Topple
blurb: Roll a tall block across floating tiles and drop it upright into the hole. 56 levels of spatial puzzles, free in your browser.

name: Snug Pack
blurb: Drag, drop and turn every item until the whole suitcase fits. A calm packing puzzle with endless trips, free in your browser.

name: Flux Weave
blurb: Turn pipes to route your flux into the cores before three rivals cut you off. A fast logic race, free in your browser.

name: Vortex Bloom
blurb: Swing the paddle around the ring and break the spinning bricks. Plan your angles and clear every level, free in your browser.

name: Twin Comets
blurb: Two comets orbit each other. Tap on the beat to swing along the path. A one-button rhythm game, free in your browser.

name: Spindle Hop
blurb: Race up a spiral tower: switch lanes, jump and duck, and grab gems as it speeds up. Free in your browser.

name: Snake
blurb: Eat, grow and don't bite your tail. The classic, free in your browser.
